definitions.explanation: The outer covering of a book, magazine, or notebook, typically containing the title and sometimes an image.

examples.japanese: この{雑誌|ざっし}の{表紙|ひょうし}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{俳優|はいゆう}だ。
examples.english: A famous actor is on the cover of this magazine.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}の{表紙|ひょうし}がボロボロになった。
{表紙|ひょうし}を{見|み}て{内容|ないよう}を{判断|はんだん}してはいけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't judge a book by its cover.

notes:
USAGE: {表紙|ひょうし} refers specifically to the cover of bound materials like books and magazines.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {表紙|ひょうし}を{飾|かざ}る (to grace the cover)
- {表紙|ひょうし}に{載|の}る (to appear on the cover)
- {表紙|ひょうし}を{めくる} (to turn the cover)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {表紙|ひょうし}{絵|え} (cover illustration)
- {表紙|ひょうし}モデル (cover model)
- {表紙|ひょうし}{写真|しゃしん} (cover photo)

RELATED TERMS:
- {裏表紙|うらびょうし} - back cover
- {背表紙|せびょうし} - spine (of a book)
- カバー - dust jacket, cover (loanword)
